first_failures.cause: The general action lexicon did not yet classify the held-out verb `verify`; the possessive deictic binding itself was correct.

held_out.product_repair: Added verify/validate to the shared inspect/investigate action family; no sentence-specific dispatch was added.

regression_repairs: Explicit Korean object pronouns no longer trigger a second omitted-argument insertion.
Korean action-like nouns are not treated as omitted-argument commands unless the predicate is final and directive-shaped.
English action-like nouns away from directive predicate position are not treated as zero-argument commands.
Korean `반면` and other `면` homographs are excluded from conditional-suffix detection.
Korean demonstrative replacement regenerates object and subject particles from the resolved antecedent.

mechanisms: TypedDeixisEllipsisResolutionIR represents possessive focus references, demonstrative focus references, and zero-argument ellipsis separately from semantic authority.
Possessive forms such as `its` and `그것의` bind to the current typed discourse focus and preserve the requested property relation.
Generic demonstratives bind only to one fresh typed focus; Korean object and subject particles are regenerated from the antecedent surface.
Direct and conditional omitted arguments can be recovered from one fresh typed focus while ambiguous or absent antecedents fail closed.
Open-vocabulary predicate ellipsis reuses the prior action over a new explicit subject without requiring a concept ID for every noun.
Conditional omitted arguments become pending DeferredActionCommitmentIR values rather than executed results.
Every resolution forces semantic_authority=false and external_execution_authorized=false.
next_residual: general bridging reference, plural reference, and implicit semantic-role recovery
adverb attachment and cleaner subject surfaces after zero-argument recovery
multi-speaker and unrestricted long-horizon antecedent competition
broad indirect speech-act and implicature inference without authority leakage
